newsitem.title: UK: GEC poised to buy Alenia Difensa - paper.
newsitem.headline: GEC poised to buy Alenia Difensa - paper.

text.p: Britain's General Electric Co Plc (GEC) is poised to take over Italian defence firm Alenia Difensa after a reorganisation to be announced on Tuesday by GEC chief executive George Simpson, The Times newspaper reported in its Monday edition.
Alenia is controlled by state-owned Finmeccanica SpA , The Times said.
Simpson has held talks with Fabio Fabiani, the Finmeccanica chairman and Giamaria Gros-Pietro, the chief executive, it said.
"The Italians are believed to have initiated the talks and favour a takeover," The Times reported.
GEC-Marconi, the GEC defence arm, is set to receive Italian government approval this month for a strategic alliance with Alenia on avionics, naval electronics radar and missile seekers.
"According to GEC insiders and analysts, the alliance is a preamble to forming a 50:50 joint venture followed by an outright purchase of the business by GEC," the paper said.
The takeover will make GEC the world's fourth-biggest defence company and the biggest outside the U.S. the paper said.
GEC and Alenia's combined defence revenues of $6.7 billion would exceed British Aerospace Plc's total $6.5 billion the paper said.
